svg.aria-label: An eco-tourism coast with rainforest hills, an eco-lodge on stilts, palm trees, a sea turtle and coral. On a writing stage in front, a noun machine turns the verb preserve into the noun preservation, an essay page sits between a gold MY VOICE bubble and a teal SOURCE VOICE bubble, and citation cards read Mielly (2023), (Alom, 2023) and (Spenceley & Rylance, 2021). A student points at them.
svg.title: Day 4 hero: nominalisation, citations and voice on an eco-tourism coast
